name: Quill
bible: A big, warm, jovial storyteller in his thirties with a broad roguish grin, laughing hazel eyes and a neat short ginger beard. Hair: a wild mane of tight GINGER-ORANGE curls, voluminous and pushed back off the forehead, falling to the shoulders. Broad shoulders and a relaxed, sturdy build. Costume: a loose WHITE linen shirt with full sleeves rolled to the elbow and an open collar; a dark BROWN leather waistcoat with brass buttons and a gold watch chain across the chest; charcoal slacks tucked into tall brown leather boots with brass buckles. WEAPON: a giant QUILL PEN used as a staff, about as tall as his head and shoulders: a pale ivory shaft with gold bands and a dark ink-black nib at its base, topped by a huge cream feather vane with a dark spine. It is held in the RIGHT hand at mid-shaft, feather upright at rest. In the LEFT hand he carries a thick open book with an oxblood-leather cover, brass corners and glowing gold pages. His magic and trails are GOLDEN INK and drifting illuminated pages: amber-gold swirls with white-hot highlights; the charged orb is a sphere of golden ink-light with pages spiralling inside.
design:
- top row: full-body neutral stance facing right with the quill staff held upright in the right hand and the open book in the left; a combat stance with the staff raised; a walking pose with the waistcoat swinging; a running pose; a jump with the curls flying; a close-up of the quill feather crown
- middle rows: six casting poses: golden ink bolts launched from the nib, a two-handed overhead swing releasing a golden crescent of ink, a charged golden orb of ink-light held at the staff head, a downward plunge with the nib driven toward the ground, an aerial sweep scattering golden pages
- bottom row: guard with the staff across the body and the book raised, a hit reaction, knocked down, a victory pose with the open book held high, the Rewritten Fate pose with golden pages swirling around him

atk-a.title: Basic combo strikes 1 and 2 (3 frames each)
frames: combo cast 1, anticipation: the quill staff drawn back by the right hip, the feather crown beginning to glow gold
combo cast 1, strike: a sharp forward thrust of the quill, its nib releasing a bolt of amber ink-light with a golden trail kept inside this cell
combo cast 1, recovery: the staff returned upright, loose golden ink droplets falling away
combo cast 2, anticipation: the staff raised high overhead in both hands, the feather vane flaring, golden pages swirling about the staff
combo cast 2, strike: a downward sweep of the quill flinging a crescent of golden ink forward and down, a bright trail kept inside this cell
combo cast 2, recovery: the staff planted low after the swing, the open book bumping at the left hip, ink sparks settling

atk-b.title: Combo finisher and aerial attack (3 frames each)
frames: combo finisher, anticipation: a big theatrical wind-up, the quill swept far back, the open book held out in the left hand with golden pages lifting
combo finisher, strike: a lunging strike forward with the nib releasing a huge burst of golden ink-light, a large bright arc trail kept inside this cell, the strongest pose
combo finisher, recovery: full extension relaxing, the curly mane and loose shirt flaring, the staff drawn back toward stance
aerial attack, anticipation: in mid-air, the quill raised high, the book open at the side with golden pages fluttering
aerial attack, strike: a sweeping mid-air swing of the quill in front that scatters a golden arc of ink and feathers, kept inside this cell
aerial attack, recovery: airborne, body tucked, the book clasped against the hip, the staff returning upright

atk-c.title: Plunge attack and heavy attack (3 frames each)
frames: plunge, dive: in mid-air diving straight down, the quill pointed down beneath the body, the book flung open with golden pages streaming upward
plunge, impact: landing in a low crouch, the quill's nib driven into the ground in front, a burst of golden ink and light
plunge, recovery: rising from the impact back toward stance, the staff drawn back up, pages gathering back toward the book
heavy attack, charge: body coiled, the quill held far back, golden ink and pages spiralling into the feather crown to form a glowing orb
heavy attack, strike: a devastating forward strike releasing a huge golden orb of ink-light, a large bright arc trail of golden pages kept inside this cell
heavy attack, follow-through: deep follow-through, the staff ending low, the golden ink sparkling and fading

sheetNotes.art: Rewritten Fate (Quill's Rift Art), six frames: 1-2 he opens the book in the left hand, golden pages lifting, and draws a quick stroke in the air with the quill; 3-4 golden ink and light spiral up around him and a warm golden aura glows on his body as the wounds close, the pages and ink swirls kept inside the cell; 5-6 the book closes with a soft glow, the quill lowered, pages settling. No legible letters or words anywhere.
sheetNotes.idle: the open book stays in the LEFT hand at the hip and the quill stays in the RIGHT hand with its feather crown upright; the curly mane bounces slightly with each breath.
sheetNotes.run: the book bounces at the left hip and the curly mane bobs with each stride; the quill is carried upright in the right hand, never dragging on the ground.
sheetNotes.misc: Taunt: he twirls the quill like a conductor's baton and gives a broad, mischievous grin with a wink. Victory: he raises the open book overhead with the quill held upright in his right hand, golden pages fanning out around him, a big grin.
sheetNotes.ko: Intro: he strolls in with the quill tapped lightly on the ground, lifts it and sweeps the feather crown in a grand theatrical flourish that scatters a few gold ink droplets, then settles into stance with the book at the hip.
